forecast_reconciliation.interpretation: A 7.471 microN more-negative force and 5.13% smaller adjacent increment increased fitted p and reduced the latest conditional correction by 29.25%. The older N12/16/24 limit did not change; therefore the frozen two-limit envelope increased by the same 7.471 microN instead of passing. The latest-only indicator is below tolerance by only 32.467 microN. Discarding the older limit now would be posthoc acceptance and is forbidden.

hypotheses.claim: The uniform hex8 force sequence is approaching a stable sublinear asymptotic regime; the N12/16/24 estimate is still pre-asymptotic.
hypotheses.limitation: Order increments .152550 and .150337 barely shrink. The absence of a drift flag does not demonstrate stabilized order or a rigorous continuum bound. Thirty-five early states fail the oldest triplet positive-order model.
hypotheses.support: All later triplet states are eligible; adjacent force/motion shrink; latest order .632920 and latest remainder 1.91% are favorable.

hypotheses.claim: Mixed bonded-plate/free-side boundary concentration and transverse/bulk discretization still contribute; current evidence cannot apportion the total force error.
hypotheses.limitation: Those controls keep radial/circumferential geometry fixed. Their approximately 61.4 microN local extrapolated P1 correction cannot certify total error or establish that radial grading alone will cure it. Curved-side geometry remains part of the uniform sequence.
hypotheses.support: Saved N8/12/16/24 rim traction proxies grow while core values stabilize. The executed fixed-N24 P1/P2/P4 plate-normal sequence has local order 2.0447 and only 3.608 microN conditional remainder.

hypotheses.claim: A simple volumetric-locking or nonlinear-residual fix is not presently evidenced.
hypotheses.limitation: These are equilibrium/consistency observations, not a reaction error bound. They neither rule out all formulation error nor replace finest-level step checks.
hypotheses.support: Current Ogden material already uses the established three-field hex8 formulation; independently computed balance, free DOFs, positive sampled J and solver residual checks pass with substantial margins.

option_assessment.cost_model_caveat: Endpoint power-law extensions and all N36/N40 resource values are extrapolations, not measurements. N^3/N^4/N^6 timing scenarios are illustrative scaling from the one observed N32 run, not a fitted complexity law. Sparse fill and readout may exceed these values; linear node RSS scaling is not an upper bound.
option_assessment.grading: Radial refinement concentrated near the bonded/free rim is scientifically motivated and could retain the current hex8 independent reader. Another purely axial plate split has little diagnostic value. A same-count radial redistribution may be cheaper per solve, but one result cannot establish total accuracy; it starts a new graded family requiring fixed geometry policy, quality/reflection controls and at least a prospective multilevel comparison. It also changes mesh-error terms, so its response cannot be inserted into the existing uniform power-law sequence.
option_assessment.higher_order: The installed FEBio source factory selects three-field-solid for uncoupled HEX8; its HEX20/HEX27 branch selects elastic-solid. A higher-order switch is not the same discrete formulation, and the current independent energy/geometry/readout supports exactly hex8. It would need its own formulation and quadrature validation; higher order alone does not remove a mixed-BC singularity. No evidence presently justifies that larger implementation before the one remaining uniform consistency check.
option_assessment.step_only: N32 S120 would fulfill a later temporal obligation but cannot repair the failed spatial envelope. The current frozen declaration explicitly reserves temporal work until spatial-model review. It is not the smallest discriminator of H1 versus persistent spatial model dependence.

primary_references.support: Official documentation recommends three-field formulation for nearly incompressible linear hex/penta elements; formulation choice is not specimen validation.
Exact source separates HEX8 three-field and HEX20/HEX27 elastic-solid factory branches.
Primary local theory documentation discusses incompressibility and three-field elements.

recommendation.decision: After independent N32 acceptance, prospectively review ONE N36 uniform global half-height compression S60 case; do not launch it under the existing N32 release and do not schedule a mesh sweep.
recommendation.forecast_only: Continuation of the latest .632920 endpoint model predicts F36=-.0361507369 N and 0.642012 mN remaining correction versus approximately .723175 mN allowance. This predicts a possible candidate, not a pass or observation. The new short refinement interval makes order inference sensitive; roughly 0.636 microN deviation toward a less-negative F36 from that forecast reaches the endpoint remainder threshold under the anchored three-grid model. Report this sensitivity rather than claiming robust accuracy from a single scalar.
frozen_analysis_for_separate_review: Reuse exactly the signed unequal-spacing root algorithm, increment floor, eligibility/null handling and 61-state accounting. Evaluate history N12/16/24, N16/24/32 and new N24/32/36; preserve older triplets in the report.

Declare before any run that the prospective two-latest-limit envelope uses the N16/24/32 and N24/32/36 models relative to F36; do not overwrite or reinterpret the failed N32 envelope. Retain all older limits so changing-window sensitivity stays visible.

Keep 1.6e-7 N + .02 max(abs(F36)), 8 micrometre motion, original individual balance/J/residual/work-energy gates, and the same order-drift and limit-disagreement rules. No unresolved non-rest states may be hidden.
A favorable screen can only nominate the selected discretization for S120 and independent review; it cannot release curves or substitute an extrapolated force for native forces in calibration.
recommendation.remaining_after_a_favorable_result: Selected-level S120 and required scaling controls, tension branch numerical adequacy, access-layer source/evidence integration, and genuine measured calibration/held-out torsion validation remain separate requirements; this diagnostic validates none of them.
recommendation.resource_scope: The proposed wall caps are a NEW prospective allocation requiring separate review/release, not an extension/retry of N32 or a change to scientific tolerances. Existing 750/1200 s caps remain frozen. N36 estimates are roughly 910-1296 native seconds plus at least the observed 112 s other work; 3 GiB and parser/output margins may still be exhausted terminally.
recommendation.stopping_rule: At most this one additional uniform observation. First resource/preparation/native/individual failure is terminal. If the prospective spatial screen still fails or order becomes unstable, stop the uniform family and review a controlled rim-graded family or established error-estimation approach; no automatic N40/N48, retries or further plate split. If it passes, review temporal verification and the other axial branch before any calibration access.
recommendation.why_N36: It is the smallest larger even cross-section level with an even full axial layer count, retaining the original whole-cell half cut and all original physics. It adds 42.38% native cells versus 95.31% for N40. The new N24/32/36 triplet consists entirely of native half-height runs and directly tests continuation of the latest uniform trend.
recommendation.why_not_N40: Simple row scaling gives about 876.7 MB primitive logs before other output, already above 768 MiB active output; linear-node RSS predicts about 3.419 GB, above 3 GiB. It is not the smallest feasible discriminator.
